fr_html: M. DE LAPRADELLE soulève la question de savoir si les mêmes incompatibilités seront applicables aux juges suppléants qu'aux juges titulaires.
en_html: M. DE LAPRADELLE raised the question as to whether the same rules concerning incompatible duties would be applicable to deputy judges and to regular judges.
